Hi Ethan / Veridian procurement team,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great questions from your ML team. Per our conversation I wanted to land a short mutual action plan (MAP) that ties the evaluation milestones to the commercial checkpoints so procurement has what you need for PO submission. High-level proposal below: 

- Evaluation phase (2–3 weeks): staged test on staging cluster; Redwood provides dedicated evaluation capacity and prioritization.
- Decision milestone: Veridian signs PO referencing deal VLD-2026-003.
- Ramp & production: phased ramp over 60 days after PO execution.
- Commercial terms: committed monthly throughput tier with tiered discounts at 50% and 100% ramp targets.
- Billing start: invoice start date aligned to either (a) first production traffic or (b) fixed date agreed in PO — whichever you prefer.

Action items for this thread:
1) Procurement: please confirm preferred payment terms (Net30/Net60) and PO file format.
2) Monica (CS): confirm ramp playbook and timeline we will include in the MAP.
3) Marcus (Finance): confirm whether a milestone-based discount can be applied and invoice cadence options.

I attached a short MAP draft for your review (Redwood_MAP_v2.pdf). If procurement prefers, we can accept a PO that references our standard MSA and the deal id.

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-minute call if helpful.

Best,
Ava Chen

Thanks Ava — this is helpful. A couple of procurement/finance questions from our side before we circulate a PO: 

- Payment terms: our standard is Net60. Would Redwood accept Net60 for the first year?
- Invoicing cadence: we prefer monthly invoices consolidated per month (line items by model/route).
- PO contents: we will upload a standard PO referencing the MSA + deal id; need a Redwood billing contact and remit-to address.
- Billing start: we generally prefer billing to begin on the "go-live" date (first production requests). If you need a fixed calendar date we can discuss.

Looping in Lydia (CFO) to confirm the PO flow. We will try to draft the PO this week.

Thanks — procurement will prepare a PO. A few specifics we need to capture in the PO and SOW:

2) Invoicing cadence: monthly, invoices submitted electronically to accounts-payable@veridian-labs.com; include invoice detail by route/model and token counts.

Hi Lydia / Ethan — thanks for the clarity. Short responses and an updated commercial summary attached.

- Payment terms: Redwood typically bills Net30; however, for strategic evaluation customers we can accept Net60 for the first 6 months on the signed PO if Veridian commits to the MAP ramp targets and an agreed committed spend. Marcus, can you confirm on the discount mechanics?
- Invoicing cadence: monthly invoices (PDF/CSV) with per-route detail — we can send electronically to accounts-payable@veridian-labs.com.
- Billing start: Redwood defines "go-live" as the first sustained production traffic (10k+ tokens across 24 hours) or the mutually agreed calendar date in the PO. We can include a 2-week warm-up window that is not billed if you prefer.

Proposed milestone-based commercial quick summary: 
1) Evaluation (no charge): up to 3 weeks — dedicated test capacity.
2) Pilot ramp (month 0–2 after go-live): 25% committed discount applied upon completion of pilot metrics.
3) Full ramp (month 3–4): additional 5% discount when 100% of committed throughput sustained for 30 days.
4) Billing & PO: monthly invoices; Redwood will accept a PO referencing Redwood, Inc. (legal entity) and deal id VLD-2026-003.

I've attached a one-pager (Redwood_Commercial_Summary.xlsx) with the numbers and a suggested clause to include Net60-for-6-months with milestone validation. If that sounds acceptable, Marcus can confirm the discount gating language and we can finalize wording for your PO.

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Ava / Lydia — thanks, that all looks reasonable. Two small requests from procurement: 

1) We can accept the milestone gating language as written and are willing to move forward with Net30 if Redwood will allow Net60 on the first invoice only (i.e., Redwood invoices Net60 for the initial month to align with our approval cycle, then Net30 thereafter).
2) Please include the Redwood legal name and remit-to address on the invoice; we will then attach the signed PO and route payment normally.

If you can send the DocuSign link for the SOW / MSA, we will route the PO immediately upon signature. Otherwise happy to sign the PO PDF and return.

Looking forward to the pilot.

Thanks,
Ethan Brown
